goal: Solve the actual CUMCM 2026 B problem with rigorous Q1/Q2 mathematics, implementable Q3/Q4 strategies, and honest locally computed evidence. Official runs and encrypted logs require the real authenticated simulator and must never be fabricated.
python: Use conda run -n py314 python for every Python execution; do not use system Python or eval Python kernel.
state_semantics: Each channel has at most one source. No_signal in Q4 cannot exclude a radius-1000 disk. Errors are fixed at the same coordinate/channel, bounded but not specified IID or uniform. Clear never changes the radio channel. Coordinates outside arena are legal. No sleeping virtual durations. No concurrent different simulator actions.
geometry_interface: geometry.py: Point = tuple[float,float]; initial_polygon(sides=180)->list[Point] is a circumscribed regular polygon around the 1800m disk; clip_bearing(poly, point, bearing_deg, error_deg=1.005)->list[Point] conservatively intersects two bearing halfplanes and the projection cap dot(g-point,u)<=1500; diameter(poly)->float; enclosing_circle(poly)->tuple[Point,float] returns minimum enclosing circle; optical_cover(poly, radius=19.9)->list[Point] guarantees its entire polygon is covered by radius-radius disks. Keep pure stdlib. All new module code can use local absolute imports as scripts run from b_solution.
coverage_interface: coverage.py: omni_waypoints(ring_radius=None) returns origin plus six equally spaced ring points; the legacy default certifies 900m and the enhanced Planner default passes 1200m, whose exact cover radius is checked by ring_cover_radius; directional_waypoints(spacing=990.0) returns finite triangular-lattice vertices that certify detection for any source position inside disk and any halfplane orientation; coverage_certificate() documents constants and proof-relevant counts. Safe overcoverage preferred to unverifiable sampled coverage.
environment_interface: environment.py: LocalSimulator(seed:int, problem:int=3, error_mode:str='smooth', scenario:str='random') object exposes act(path:str, position:Point|None=None, channel:int|None=None)->dict matching accepted successful official responses; reset at /enter; no calls auto-created. Include generator, deterministic spatial error fixed at same location (smooth, extreme, iid_location modes), hidden truth private to environment, and summary()->dict for evaluation only AFTER /exit. Summary: n_sources, n_cleared, fraction_cleared, virtual_time_s, average_time_s, distance_m, measures, switches, clear_attempts, failed_clears, real_duration_s. Planner must consume only act, not truth. Simulation is explicitly local synthetic evidence, not official.
client_interface: client.py: HTTPClient(base_url:str, robot_id:str, log_path:str) has same act method, sequential JSON/HTTP, correct request IDs and idempotent transient retry, accepted handling, deadline bookkeeping, no automatic entry or formal-run startup. Expose close(). No CLI needed; Main owns runner.
validation: ALL subagents skip formatters, linters, builds and tests/experiments. Main alone runs numerical checks after integration. Do not modify original problem/attachments, existing prompt.md or stale C-topic plan. Do not create Markdown docs. Reasoning notes may be .txt. Report uncertainty and assumptions explicitly. No recursive subagents.
